title: SDK Skill Browser HowTo
desc: T2 HowTo: step-by-step guide to set up, run, and maintain the skill browser marketing pipeline
steps: INITIAL SETUP: git clone wkappbot-sdk. pip install nothing needed (stdlib only). Ensure D:/GitHub/WKAppBot/bin/wkappbot.hq/skills/ exists (HQ skill catalog). Set GH_PAT env var for Pages status check and OAuth.
BUILD: python scripts/build-skill-page.py -- auto-finds HQ catalog, filters apps, masks secrets, writes docs/skills/index.html. Run after any skill changes to refresh.
GITHUB PAGES: Settings > Pages > Source: main branch /docs. URL: https://kiexpert.github.io/wkappbot-sdk/. Check: gh api repos/.../pages
GHA TRIGGER FROM CORE: add .github/workflows/notify-sdk.yml to Core repo with repository_dispatch event skill-catalog-updated targeting kiexpert/wkappbot-sdk. SDK workflow listens and rebuilds.

PRO SUBSCRIBER MGMT: gh api repos/kiexpert/wkappbot-harness/collaborators -X PUT -f permission=pull to add subscriber. Remove: gh api repos/.../collaborators/USERNAME -X DELETE. Payment flow via payment-to-license-activation skill.
LAYOUT CUSTOMIZATION: edit docs/skills/index.html JS section HERO_QUOTE to change reflection text. Edit CSS var --accent for brand color. Edit CATEGORY_MAP in skills-data.js for grouping.
HARNESS MONETIZATION: Free=view skill titles+preview. Pro=full steps+no blur. Enterprise=custom skill tree. Subscription = GitHub collaborator on wkappbot-harness private repo.
author: claude
